ships.name: Safari Quest
ships.notes: Reaches limited-access wilderness areas (no more than two groups of twelve guests per day). Decks: Observation (hot tub, fitness), Bridge (Admiral cabins, library, open bridge), Main (dining, bar, lounge, Pathfinder and single cabins), Cabin deck (Navigator). Open seating table service; all drinks included. Full-beam swim step, underwater bow camera, kayaks, paddleboards, skiffs, hiking poles.

ships.name: Safari Explorer
ships.notes: Hawaii in winter, Alaska in summer (Prince William Sound, Aleutians). Bridge deck: rooftop sun lounge, fitness, open bridge, Commodore Suites, hot tub (Alaska only). Plated meals, open seating, drinks included. Kayaks, SUPs, skiffs, snorkel gear, rubber boots, full-beam swim step.

ships.name: Wilderness Adventurer
ships.notes: Sun deck hot tub and fitness; observation deck at the bow; EZ Dock launch platform on main deck. Lounge with GPS map and under-bow camera channels. Buffet and plated meals; drinks included. Snorkel gear and wetsuits.

ships.name: Wilderness Explorer
ships.notes: The only UnCruise boat to have over-wintered in Southeast Alaska (two seasons). Sun deck open bridge; lounge with wrap-around glass, bar and bow hot tub; EZ Dock on main deck. Drinks included.

ships.name: Wilderness Discoverer
ships.notes: First 'Wilderness' boat in the fleet. Bar top and tap tower made from a yellow cedar log found in Peril Strait. Shoal draft reaches waters closed to bigger boats. Two on-deck hot tubs; EZ Dock; snorkel gear and wetsuits. Drinks included.

ships.name: Safari Endeavour
ships.notes: Four guest decks; two outdoor hot tubs; bow viewing area; lounge with GPS and bow-camera channels; boxed lunches on long excursion days; Commodore Suites with private balcony. Drinks included.

ships.name: Wilderness Legacy
ships.notes: Carved wooden cabinetry; Owner's Suite; Sea Dragon launch platform; most spacious viewing decks in the fleet, three bow viewing areas; largest lounge in the Alaska fleet; two hot tubs; plated meals. Only boat in the fleet with an elevator (not to bridge deck). Admiral 309 has a short ramp and grab bars (not ADA accessible).
